comment: Source read at commit 2b2ad81. Sunflower.cpp:88 calls configParam(PARAM_SELECTION, 6.f, -6.f, 0.f) with the minimum above the maximum, so the selection counts down across the knob's clockwise travel. The maker named none of the twelve signal inputs and called all twelve trimpots 'Amp ', so the tooltips do not distinguish them; the ring position is the only thing that does. Neither output was given a configOutput, so the mix jack's tooltip is empty. A second output, OUT_TEST, is declared with no PortWidget and cannot be reached.
